notes: Variante d'ay-o003 (unforgettable), qui a fait 60 900 vues sur son premier passage mesuré, soit environ 40 fois la médiane du label. Schéma unforgettable (444 k vues le 26/09 chez @stonemag.co, preuve jusqu'au 26/10). Items neufs : aucun repris d'ay-o003, de 452e706f ni des autres originaux. Accroches écrites : « Underrated skills that will make you unforgettable » (retenue : le gabarit exact du gagnant, « underrated » promet du neuf), « Old school skills that make you unforgettable » (écartée : se traduit mal), « Skills that make people remember you for years » (écartée : plus longue, sans le mot clé). slides.texte_overlay:
Underrated skills that will make you
unforgettable
Learn to write a real birthday message. Not "HBD bro." One line about something they did this year. "Still can't believe you actually ran that half marathon." Takes a minute. They'll screenshot it.
Learn to apologize properly. No "sorry if you were offended." Say "I was wrong, and I'm sorry." Then fix it. People forget the mistake. They remember the guy who owned it without a speech.
Learn to joke about the situation, never the person. "Of course it starts raining the second we sit outside." Laughing together at bad luck brings people closer, faster than any compliment ever will.
Know the story behind things. Five minutes a day of history, art or science. Like why we clink glasses before drinking. Little stories turn a boring moment into one people repeat to their friends.
slides.texte_sophia: Know the story behind things. A micro-learning app like the Sophia app gives you five minutes a day of history, art or science. Little stories turn a boring moment into one people repeat.

slides.texte_overlay: Learn to celebrate other people's wins out loud. Friend got the job? Don't just like the post. Call him. "Dude, that's huge, drinks are on me." People never forget who was genuinely happy for them.
Learn to keep a secret. When someone tells you something private, it stays with you. No hints, no "I can't say, but..." Being the one people trust is worth more than any story you could tell.
Learn to show up when it's not fun. Helping someone move, visiting a friend in hospital, the boring Sunday errand. Anyone comes to the party. People never forget who came on moving day.
